CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, MaY 10,2023

1  Chairperson Simison called the meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:31 P.m.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chairperson Simison led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Jason Simison, Thomas
  Allison, Jeffry Allred, and Jason Lorge' Advisory personnel present:
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City Attorney Scott Porter,
  Principal flanner Candice Bowcock, Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera, and
  Assisiant Planner Parker Stringfellow. Absent: Commissioner Jeremy
  Conrad and Secretary Natalie Hiatt.

4.  MINUTES  - April 12,2023
  It was moved by Commissioner Lorge and seconded by Commissioner
  Allison to approve the minutes of April 12, 2023. Motion carried by a 4'0
  vote.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

 Planning Commission Minutes
May 10,2023

  Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera presented his staff report.

  There were no public comments.

  There was a question of the HOA's stance on the proposed variance.

  Russ Sullivan of the Mountain Springs HOA stated that they were all good
  with the proposal.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allred and seconded by Commissioner
  Allison to approve Resolution 1301. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow presented his staff report.

  Chairperson Simison opened public comment. The applicant Shannon
  Saravia was present.

  There were no public comments'

  Commissioner Allison questioned the parking and the sound impacts. Mr'
  Scherer addressed the parking concem and Ms. Saravia addressed the
  concern about noise.

  It was moved by Chairperson Lorge and seconded by Commissioner Allred
  to approve Resolution No. 1304. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

 Planning Commission Minutes
May 10, 2023

  The commissioners had various questions about the projects. Staff
  addressed the questions.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allred and seconded by Commissioner
  Lorge to approve Resolution No. 1305. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

  Mr. Scherer introduced City Attorney Scott Porter.

ADJOURNMENT

  Chambers, 3660 "D'Street, La Verne, CA 91750.
